name: Billionaire Match
source:
After you spend the best night of your life with a sexy stranger, you find out that he's tech billionaire Maxwell Adams... and the paparazzi think you're his fiancée! You agree to a fake relationship to promote his new dating app and through your sister's wedding, but the chemistry you feel with him is absolutely real. Are you willing to swipe right on this whirlwind romance?

[From in-app]
translation:
与一位性感的陌生人共度人生最美妙的一夜后，你才发现，他竟是科技界的亿万富翁麦克斯韦尔·亚当斯……而狗仔队认定你是他的未婚妻！为了宣传他新推出的约会应用，也为了应付姐妹的婚礼，你们同意假扮情侣。然而，你与他之间的心动却千真万确。你愿意为这场旋风般的恋爱向右滑动，选择心动吗？

[摘自应用内]
